topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session, connects the material to histopathology practicals, and outlines the lecture's learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Identification of Transforming Oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the discovery of transforming viruses led to the identification of cellular proto-oncogenes and the development of assays to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Mechanisms of Oncogenic and Tumor Suppressor Mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classes of cancer mutations and illustrate how mutations in regulators like RB and p53 disrupt cell cycle control and cellular function.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Progression of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the molecular sources of sequence and chromosomal instability and examine how accumulating genomic defects drive multistep tumor development.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inherited germline mutations accelerate tumorigenesis and influence ongoing tumor evolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, offers recommended reading, and previews the next lecture.
